method.runtime: Live FidelityRuntime singleton driven from a probe LocalScript injected into PlayerScripts (same require cache as Main.client); setOverride(tier) forced each tier, setOverride(nil) restored auto.
method.lookdev: LookDev is single-active, so 'all on' = measured baseline + the sum of the eight per-candidate deltas. Each applier owns a disjoint container (LookDevCropShowcase, LookDevHubPropDetails, NPC child parts, material swaps, UI, Sounds), so the deltas are additive.
method.census: Workspace descendants within 100 studs of each MapSpec hub centre: instances (BasePart or Model), parts (BasePart), and estimated triangles from Roblox primitive Shape (Block/Wedge=12, Cylinder=32, Ball/Sphere=320).
method.triangle_estimate_note: Roblox does not expose a primitive triangle count; the per-shape table is an explicit engineering estimate. It is applied identically to baseline and all-on counts, and was cross-checked against the pure-data recipes.
method.frustum_crosscheck: Attempted using Camera:WorldToViewportPoint but returned zero parts in the probe VM (WorldToViewportPoint returns pixels and the probe camera census under-reported); discarded. The 100-stud census is the reported metric.

budgets.note: Project numbers until measured. Draw calls are not exposed to scripts, so BasePart count within the hub census is used as a conservative upper-bound proxy.

matrix_note: Baseline and all-on counts were identical across all three tiers: none of the eight LookDev candidates branches on FidelityTier, and tier changes affect particles/lighting rather than these static parts. Tier forcing was verified via FidelityRuntime.get() for all 18 combinations.

recipe_crosscheck.note: Lune computation from the pure-data recipe modules matches the live Studio shape histogram exactly for crops and hubprops.

verdict.triangles: PASS — worst all-on 49,208 triangles (ronda, all tiers) = 9.8% of the 500k Sedang budget.
verdict.draw_call_proxy: OVER in the all-on stress case — 580–712 parts vs ~500. Baseline alone (230–347 parts) is within budget. The entire excess is the 339-part Studio-only crops review showcase.
verdict.rendah: Same geometry as the other tiers: worst all-on 712 parts / 49,208 triangles. Triangles pass; draw-call proxy exceeds only because of the Studio-only showcase.
verdict.shipping_state: PASS — all LookDev candidates are off by default behind a Studio-only gate, so the shipping scene is the measured baseline (≤347 parts, ≤19,780 triangles within 100 studs of any hub).

decision_for_designer.title: Cap the Studio-only crops showcase on low tiers
decision_for_designer.proposal: Show only the mature 'siap' stage on Rendah/Sedang (12 models, 144 parts, 13,088 triangles) and keep all 36 models on Tinggi for full review. This cuts the worst all-on proxy from 712 to about 517 parts (495 at the pasar/spawn view) while preserving complete art review on flagship.
decision_for_designer.status: PARKED — not applied; workshop change to CropModelCandidates.stagesByTier + LookDevCrops + a locking spec is the follow-up.
decision_for_designer.reason: The trim is a designer choice about review fidelity vs stress-view budget; no agent changed delivered item-7 art mid-check.
